text: Acceptance 2/3: the status watermark acknowledges undelivered member mentions. In-memory createFeed reproduction: resume (null,10), status=51, mention 51; hold onItem's promise and stop/restart -> saved=(51,10), delivered=[], mentionCursor=51. The resumedFrom check permanently skips 51. Removing the eager cursor assignment in memory restores delivered=[51]. Separate the stream bootstrap watermark from delivered state and preserve pending mentions across restarts.
